answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 60979 Country: Bangladesh Title: dua of sifa Question: I have a serious heart disease. I have Asthma and high blood pressure. I am trying many types of medicine. But medicine is not working but I am still taking medicine because I have heard that it is sunnah. But how can I make dua of Shifa to Allah? Is there any dua of Shifa from heart disease? Answer ID: 60979 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1102/1081/H=11/1436) After each salah and at the time of going to bed, recite surah Quraish three times with durood 3-3 times before and after and then blow on your hands and pass your hands over your body. Also keep on taking medicine along with supplicating Allah regularly. May Allah give you health! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
